backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the e-commerce backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for products, orders, user profiles, and site settings, with admin access control, Razorpay/Stripe integration, and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that FloatingWhatsApp dynamically fetches the WhatsApp number from the backend and that AdminSettings invalidates the React Query cache after saving, with references to the relevant source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the app including hooks, pages, components, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property color tokens for both light and dark themes, including sidebar, chart, and semantic UI colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, loading Cormorant Garamond and Inter fonts from Google Fonts, the Razorpay checkout script, and the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file that sets up TanStack Router with customer and protected admin route trees, wraps customer pages in a layout that includes FloatingWhatsApp, and configures React Query and theming providers.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: A route guard component that redirects unauthenticated or non-admin users to the admin login page, showing a loading spinner while authentication and admin status are being verified.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar (desktop and mobile) containing navigation links and a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: Admin UI component that simulates AI image generation by selecting a curated Unsplash botanical image based on a text prompt, with a preview and a 'Use Image' action.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: A modal dialog displaying full order details (customer info, items, payment status) and allowing admins to update the fulfillment status via a dropdown select.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: A modal form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, image upload, AI image generation, and key-value specifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: A read-only modal that displays a user's profile details including name, email, principal ID, registration date, and total order count.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-out cart drawer component that displays cart items with quantity controls and a remove button, shows a total, and navigates to checkout on confirmation.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Renders a fixed floating WhatsApp button that fetches the contact number from the backend (with a fallback), opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat on click, and includes entrance animation, tooltip, and pulse ring effects.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with brand info, quick navigation links, contact details, copyright year, and a 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution.
A slide-in mobile navigation drawer with Home/Shop links and an admin login/logout button, rendered as an overlay when open.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop nav links, a cart icon with item count badge, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, status badges, price, and Add to Cart / Buy Now action buttons, navigating to the product detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: A headless component that seeds the database with sample products when the product list is empty on mount.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: An in-memory React context providing cart state and operations (add, remove, update quantity, clear) for Product objects with bigint IDs, without session persistence.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: A React context providing cart state persisted to sessionStorage, with operations for adding, removing, and updating string-keyed cart items, plus a cart open/close toggle.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the application, covering CRUD operations for products, orders, users, site settings, and payment configuration via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Custom hook that integrates the Razorpay payment gateway, handling checkout initialization, payment success/failure navigation, and cart clearing.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for both the customer storefront (Ayurvedic theme) and admin panel palettes in light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and the InternetIdentityProvider.
Admin dashboard that aggregates orders, products, and users into summary stat cards, a monthly revenue bar chart, a fulfillment-status pie chart, and a recent orders table.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page that orchestrates Internet Identity authentication, attempts to claim/verify admin status via the backend actor, and redirects to the dashboard on success or shows an access-denied error.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin orders management page that fetches all orders, displays summary stats, and provides search, filter, and sort controls with a detail modal for individual orders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin products management page that lists all products with search and status stats, and supports adding, editing, and deleting products via a form modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store information, Razorpay payment key, announcement banner, and WhatsApp contact number, with save actions backed by query mutations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin users page that fetches and displays all registered users in a searchable table, with a detail modal for viewing individual user information.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal options, and triggers Razorpay checkout for the total order amount.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details via a form and initiates a Stripe payment session, redirecting the user to the Stripe-hosted checkout URL on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero banner, feature highlights, and featured/all product sections using data fetched via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Static page shown after a failed payment, offering buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Static confirmation page displayed after a successful payment, thanking the user and linking back to the shop or home.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that fetches a single product by ID, displays its image, description, and status, and supports add-to-cart and Razorpay buy-now flows with quantity selection.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Shop listing page that fetches all products and provides search, category, and status filters to display a filtered grid of ProductCard components.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting numbers as Indian Rupee currency strings and converting nanosecond BigInt timestamps to localized date strings.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Defines a static array of sample ProductInput objects (Ubtan, Neem, Sandalwood, etc.) used to seed the product catalog with varied statuses and specifications.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining an Ayurvedic brand palette (forest, sage, golden, terracotta, etc.), custom fonts, shadows, admin-specific color tokens, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for 'Nature Glow', tracking a known bug where the WhatsApp button does not reflect updated phone numbers saved via the admin panel due to stale React Query cache.
